problem: The structural website screenshot assurance reached real browser evidence and exposed nested canonical wrappers, missing mobile navigation ARIA state, Firefox-inoperable desktop mega menus, redirect inspection races and Firefox navigation-abort false positives.
root_cause: Canonical shell projection was not fully idempotent and pinned V18 navigation relied on pointer-capability assumptions without a complete machine-readable state contract; the assurance runner also treated redirect/context transitions and browser-specific abort codes as hard failures.
decision: Repair the canonical build and the browser evidence semantics without widening CLS or responsive thresholds.
prevention: Canonical shell extraction always unwraps the deepest existing #view-inhoud/page-inhoud before re-projection.
V18 mobile navigation synchronizes aria-controls and aria-expanded from the drawer state.
V18 desktop mega navigation supports pointer, focus, click, Escape and outside-click across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
Redirect inspection retries after navigation context replacement.
Only exact browser navigation-abort codes are excluded from hard resource failures.
